In RAN#94-e meeting, a new Rel-18 WID on MIMO [1] was agreed. From 7 objectives, there are two objectives for DMRS enhancements, as shown below. For objective#3 (increased DMRS ports), in RAN1#109-e meeting, the following agreement was made. From FL perspective, the highest priority in RAN1#110 is to down select from the agreed 5 options. This document contains summary of the company’s proposal and FL proposals. Multiple companies (FUTUREWEI, Huawei/HiSilicon, ZTE, vivo, Lenovo, OPPO, CATT, Xiaomi, Samsung, Fraunhofer IIS/HHI MediaTek , Ericsson, Qualcomm, Nokia) show evaluation results to compare the 5 options. Evaluation results are summarized in “Summary of evaluation results” in https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_ran/WG1_RL1/TSGR1_110/Inbox/drafts/9.1(NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL)/9.1.3.1%20-%20DMRS/Ro
